utility: 1 iff totalCents exactly equals independently computed expected cents; otherwise 0
noop: evaluated by the same evaluator; no special-case credit
cost: policy-only intervention cost; never added to evaluator utility
applicability: N/A interventions are recorded with applicable=false and excluded from failure counts and training labels
infrastructure: infrastructure_invalid is recorded separately and excluded from training/effect estimates
abstain: abstain is a policy decision equivalent to selecting noop, not an execution outcome
independence: evaluator receives specification and output only; never fault condition, action label, or features
